validity.researcher_notes:
gem.wiki (gem.wiki/Sui-Multan_Gas_Loopline_II) returned HTTP 403 to both the automated harvester (wiki_citations.json empty for this row, confirmed) and a direct WebFetch attempt -- no leads available from the sheet's own wiki page this run. All 6 tracker [ref] cells for this row were MISSING_REF to start (Status, Fuel, PipelineType, Length, Diameter, Location), so this is new sourcing, not re-verification. WebSearch budget was exhausted for the session before I could run open-web queries, and every general search engine I reached via WebFetch (Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Startpage, Marginalia) either CAPTCHA-blocked the request or returned obviously irrelevant/unreliable results (Bing repeatedly substituted 'Sui' cryptocurrency/SUI-tax content regardless of quoting) -- none of those are usable evidence and none are cited. SNGPL's and OGRA's own websites 403/404'd on direct WebFetch.

However this row's ALREADY-CITED Route [ref] URL (out of scope for the refs leg itself, but a legitimate primary source I could inspect for leads on the in-scope value cells) resolved live (verifier: OK, 200) and is SNGPL's own official 'Transmission Network AS ON 31-03-2022' map (drawing T-1). I downloaded and visually inspected it. It shows a compressor-station node explicitly labeled 'Bhong' (in Punjab near Rahim Yar Khan/Sadiqabad, matching StartLocation=Bhong/StartState-Province=Punjab exactly), from which FOUR separate parallel red 'Existing Pipeline' lines run northeast to Multan, individually labelled 18", 24", 30" and 36" -- i.e. exactly the four diameters recorded across this Bhong-origin/Sui-origin pipeline family in GEM (P4090 Sui-Multan Gas Pipeline=24in, P4091 Sui-Multan Gas Loopline I=30in, P4097 THIS ROW=18in, P4098 Sui-Multan Gas Loopline III=36in). The map's legend has only one line-style for pipe ('Existing Pipeline'; no proposed/planned symbol is used anywhere on the sheet), directly supporting Status=operating and PipelineType=transmission (the map's own title). This is a primary, self-reported, dated, still-live source from the owning utility -- not GEM, not gem.wiki.

Second, independent corroboration: this repo's already-registered GulfPub (Petroleum Economist / PE World Map, source_tier=2) dataset -- sources/gulfpub/data/SDE.NG_Pipelines_Global.geojson -- carries a Pakistan gas record named 'AC1-X - Multan' (AC1-X is GulfPub's label for the Bhong junction) running Bhong->Multan, status='Operating', diameter=18in, operator/owner='Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd'. Endpoints, diameter, owner and status all match GEM's P4097 exactly. GulfPub has no single public per-record URL I can pass url_verifier (its provenance is a licensed scrape, origin_url is just gulfpub.com's homepage, which won't contain 'Bhong'/'Multan' text), so it is NOT included in proposed_refs, but it is genuine independent corroboration recorded here per project convention (GulfPub = registered Tier-2 corroboration source, not a fabricated citation).

EXISTENCE: confirmed -- two independent sources (SNGPL's own current map + GulfPub's independently-scraped industry database) both show a real, operating, SNGPL-owned 18in gas line from Bhong to Multan. Not a GEM-only/hallucinated entity.
CLASSIFICATION: confirmed -- transmission trunk/loopline (long-haul, large-diameter, SNGPL system-gas corridor), not a gathering/feeder line. Map title is literally 'Transmission Network'.
DUPLICATE: checked against the roster's other 3 Sui-Multan-family rows (P4090 dia24 Sui->Multan, P4091 dia30 Sui->Multan Loopline I, P4098 dia36 Sui->Multan Loopline III). The map shows these as FOUR genuinely distinct parallel pipes at the same node, not a re-description of one pipe under multiple ProjectIDs -- no duplicate/double-count. GEM's choice of 'Bhong' (rather than 'Sui') as the start point for P4097/P4098 specifically (vs 'Sui' for P4090/P4091) is independently confirmed correct by both the map and GulfPub -- this loopline evidently only parallels the downstream Bhong-to-Multan portion of the corridor, not the full Sui-to-Multan run, and that is not a labeling error.
ATTRIBUTION: Owner1='Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd (SNGPL)' 100% confirmed by both sources (SNGPL's own map; GulfPub operator field verbatim 'Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd'). StartLocation/EndLocation/Province/Country all confirmed by the map.
Fuel=Gas confirmed by context (SNGPL = Sui Northern GAS Pipelines Ltd; the map is literally SNGPL's gas transmission network) and independently by the SNGPL Wikipedia article's description of the company as a natural-gas transmission/distribution utility (System Gas + RLNG).

Caveat: the map is schematic/non-metric (consistent with this row's existing RouteAccuracy='very low (straight line/schematic)') and cannot corroborate the 256.82 km LengthKnown figure -- see the separate spec concern below.

validity.recommendation: Do not silently keep 256.82 km unexamined. Check SNGPL/OGRA as-built pipeline-length tables (not just the schematic transmission map, which carries no scale) to adjudicate the ~12% gap against GulfPub's figure before treating LengthKnown as settled.
validity.researcher_notes: LengthKnown=256.82 km is NOT independently confirmed and has one material disagreement on record. GulfPub's matching record for the same physical line (same Bhong->Multan endpoints, same 18in diameter, same SNGPL owner, same 'Operating' status -- see the validity entry above) reports Length=179 (GulfPub Pakistan-gas length units are confirmed miles per sources/gulfpub/manifest.yml, i.e. 179 mi = 288.02 km) -- about 31 km / ~12% longer than GEM's 256.82 km. SNGPL's own transmission map (this row's existing Route [ref]) is schematic with no scale bar and cannot be used to adjudicate a length figure either way (consistent with the row's own RouteAccuracy='very low (straight line/schematic)'). I found no third source and no way to determine which figure (if either) is the true as-built pipe length, so I am flagging the disagreement rather than passing it silently and NOT proposing a replacement value -- 256.82 km may simply reflect a different route alignment/measurement basis than GulfPub's aggregate corridor mileage, but a 12% gap on a real spec crosses the 'material disagreement' bar and should be checked against a primary length table before the field is treated as settled. No fill proposed; leaving LengthKnown as-is with this caveat.

summary: P4097 confirmed (caveat): SNGPL's own current transmission map + GulfPub's independent industry database both corroborate a real, operating, SNGPL-owned 18in Bhong-to-Multan transmission line (existence/classification/duplicate/attribution/status/fuel/diameter/location all check out, high tier, 2 independent sources) -- but LengthKnown=256.82 km is flagged concern/spec: GulfPub reports the same line at ~288 km (179 mi), a ~12% gap, unresolved (no fill proposed, no capacity fill attempted since GulfPub's Capacity_mmcfd=300 for this record matches a known placeholder pattern repeated across unrelated Pakistan lines).
